en: Colorized historic view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Elegant multi‑story buildings line the left bank of a canal or river, while on the right is a grand neo‑classical colonnade with many columns and balustrades. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the wide walkway. The scene is framed by wooded hills and dense town buildings in the background. Red printed titles at the top read "Kreuzstrasse.", "Karlsbad.", and "Mühlbrunnen‑Kolonnade.".
